purpose: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (BCBS 238), Net Stable Funding Ratio (BCBS 295), and Leverage Ratio (BCBS 270, finalized BCBS 360) point-in-time calculator from caller-supplied HQLA positions, outflow/inflow categories, ASF/RSF items, and capital/exposure figures. Deterministic single-scenario point calculation, distinct from the Monte Carlo stress distribution in sim-01-lcr-nsfr-liquidity-stress-test. Provable node counterpart to tools/469-lcr-calculator.html, tools/470-nsfr-calculator.html, and tools/471-leverage-ratio-calculator.html.
